hook.en: Two friends save RM100 a month. One keeps it in a drawer; the other earns compound interest. After 10 years the second friend has noticeably more — without saving a single extra ringgit.
hook.bm: Dua sahabat menyimpan RM100 sebulan. Seorang menyimpan dalam laci; seorang lagi mendapat faedah kompaun. Selepas 10 tahun, sahabat kedua mempunyai jauh lebih banyak — tanpa menyimpan seringgit tambahan pun.

bigIdeas.en: Savings earn interest: simple interest I = Prt, or compound interest MV = P(1 + r/n)ⁿᵗ.
bigIdeas.bm: Simpanan memperoleh faedah: faedah mudah I = Prt, atau faedah kompaun MV = P(1 + r/n)ⁿᵗ.

bigIdeas.en: Investments (shares, unit trusts, property) can earn more but carry risk; compare return, risk and liquidity.
bigIdeas.bm: Pelaburan (saham, amanah saham, hartanah) boleh memberi pulangan lebih tinggi tetapi berisiko; bandingkan pulangan, risiko dan kecairan.

bigIdeas.en: Credit and loans cost money (interest); use them wisely and pay on time.
bigIdeas.bm: Kredit dan pinjaman ada kosnya (faedah); gunakan dengan bijak dan bayar tepat pada masanya.

definition.en: The original amount saved or borrowed.
definition.bm: Jumlah asal yang disimpan atau dipinjam.

definition.en: Interest on the principal only: I = Prt.
definition.bm: Faedah atas prinsipal sahaja: I = Prt.

definition.en: Interest also earned on earlier interest.
definition.bm: Faedah turut diperoleh atas faedah terdahulu.

definition.en: How quickly an asset can be turned into cash.
definition.bm: Seberapa cepat aset boleh ditukar kepada tunai.

definition.en: Loan interest calculated on the original principal for the whole period.
definition.bm: Faedah pinjaman dikira atas prinsipal asal bagi seluruh tempoh.

question.en: RM5000 is saved at 4% per annum, compounded every 6 months. Find the amount after 2 years.
question.bm: RM5000 disimpan pada kadar 4% setahun, dikompaun setiap 6 bulan. Cari jumlahnya selepas 2 tahun.

steps.en: P = 5000, r = 0.04, n = 2 (twice a year), t = 2.
steps.bm: P = 5000, r = 0.04, n = 2 (dua kali setahun), t = 2.

prompt.en: Ravi invests RM300 every month in a unit trust. The unit prices in three months are RM1.00, RM1.50 and RM0.75. Find his average cost per unit (RM).
prompt.bm: Ravi melabur RM300 setiap bulan dalam amanah saham. Harga unit dalam tiga bulan ialah RM1.00, RM1.50 dan RM0.75. Cari purata kos seunit (RM).

explanation.en: Units = 300 + 200 + 400 = 900. Average cost = RM900 ÷ 900 = RM1.00 (lower than the average price) — this is ringgit cost averaging.
explanation.bm: Unit = 300 + 200 + 400 = 900. Purata kos = RM900 ÷ 900 = RM1.00 (lebih rendah daripada purata harga) — inilah purata kos ringgit.

prompt.en: A credit card balance of RM3000 is not paid. The interest rate is 18% per annum. Estimate the interest for one month (RM).
